channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Cory Joseph | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Cory Joseph from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Paolo Banchero on Cory Joseph
item.description:
Paolo Banchero on what he learned about how having a point guard like Cory Joseph in the starting 5 at the end of the season benefited him and the #Magic's offense:

“I think having a ball-handler out there at the guard position can help me a lot, can help Franz a lot. Cory did a good job of stepping in, being himself, doing all the little things that mattered to winning, and I definitely think it helped us. I think it was a good change ... he came in and took a little bit off of me and Franz, played a little bit with the ball-handling and stuff like that, which did make our lives a little easier.”

Paolo Banchero on Cory Joseph, May 1, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Myck Kabongo on Kawhi Leonard, Cory Joseph
item.description:
Luckily for Kabongo, a couple of Spurs teammates saved the day.

“Thankfully I had great vets in Kawhi [Leonard] and Cory [Joseph] that took care of that fine for me,”

Myck Kabongo on Kawhi Leonard, Cory Joseph, May 23, 2024. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Dario Saric, Cory Joseph
item.description:
Kerr likened the additions of Saric and Joseph to Otto Porter Jr. and Nemanja Bjelica for the 2022 championship season, and even to Zaza Pachulia and David West in previous years.

“We needed guys like Saric and Cory Joseph who have been through the NBA rigors and understand what it means to be a leader from the middle of the roster and how important that is,”

Steve Kerr on Dario Saric, Cory Joseph, Jul 22, 2023. Source: San Jose Mercury-News.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Cory Joseph
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Casey on Cory Joseph's strong stretch of basketball:

“He's more aggressive, and I want him to be more aggressive. If Cade is having a tough time because he's having the best defender on him, go get the ball and be aggressive.”

Dwane Casey on Cory Joseph, Jan 30, 2022. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Isaiah Stewart on Cory Joseph, Rodney McGruder
item.description:
#Pistons Isaiah Stewart on Rodney McGruder's (and Cory Joseph's) veteran experience:

“They've been in games and certain situations and they've seen a lot of things we haven't seen.”

Isaiah Stewart on Cory Joseph, Rodney McGruder, Jan 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Cory Joseph
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Casey on Cory Joseph's personality:

“I always call Cory the Pied Piper. He's a guy that players gravitate toward.”

Dwane Casey on Cory Joseph, Oct 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Cory Joseph
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on Cory Joseph:

“Cory's been through it. He played with a top championship program in San Antonio, that's one reason we brought him to Toronto.”

Dwane Casey on Cory Joseph, Apr 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Cory Joseph
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Cory Joseph:

“He remembers things and he just needs to be refreshed... He's just a great person and he fits our MO of what we're trying to build here.”

Dwane Casey on Cory Joseph, Mar 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Cory Joseph
item.description:
Ryan Wolstat:Popovich on Cory Joseph:

“He'd still be with us if we could have paid him. But you can't pay everybody.”

Gregg Popovich on Cory Joseph, Dec 9, 2015. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Cory Joseph, Anthony Bennett
item.description:
Ryan Wolstat:Lowry on Joseph and Bennett:

“They take a lot more media obligations away from us, give it to the Canadians!”

Kyle Lowry on Cory Joseph, Anthony Bennett, Sep 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.
